case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's central, convenient location, clean and comfortable rooms (including comfortable beds and good soundproofing) and a varied breakfast selection. Many reviewers complimented friendly, helpful staff, though a few cited unfriendly or unprofessional reception. Some negatives included occasional late housekeeping, traffic noise for street-facing rooms, and limited breakfast options such as only Nescafé coffee and no fresh orange juice.
